name: chess-coach
description: Play timed chess games against Stockfish with an AI coach that pauses the clock to explain your mistakes.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run prepare-engine && vite build
scripts.build:artifact: npm run prepare-engine && vite build --mode artifact
scripts.typecheck: vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
